meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.

A single edit at 11:52 PM on what date, and is that on a document I can read myself, or is it something you're describing to me? People paste from their own drafts every day, Hale. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." Removing it is the right outcome, Hale, but not to make me happy, and not as a favour. I'll want it in an email before my call: the zero withdrawn, and nothing placed on Owen's record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you offered to remove the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require written confirmation that the zero is withdrawn and that nothing has been or will be placed on Owen's record. I asked for that confirmation by email before my 4:40 call today, and I have not received it.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with your offer to remove the zero on the table and nothing agreed in writing, and she still wants written confirmation of the withdrawal, a promise that nothing goes on Owen's record, and an answer on whether Owen was heard before the zero went in.
What moved her: "612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM" did not move her, but it was specific and timed, so she asked a real question about the date and the document instead of only attacking.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this" and "if that makes you happy" gave up your case under pressure without testing it, so she took the concession and pressed for more.
Try next time: when you raised the 11:52 PM edit, give the date and turn the screen so she can read the version history herself, and open with one sentence admitting the zero went in before anyone called her.
